Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, director of Kamal Adwan Hospital, has been held in Israeli prison since December 2024 without charge, with recent reports indicating severe physical and psychological abuse.

The systematic detention of medical professionals undermines the basic infrastructure of healthcare in conflict zones.

This is a WHO error. The state justifies detention as security, but the reality is the destruction of medical capacity.

This is a classic case of power projection through the dehumanization of an opponent. By denying medical care, the system creates a high-strain, unstable environment.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The systemic abuse of non-combatants creates a cycle of violence.

The Unavoidable Truth: The doctor is in critical condition due to detention conditions.

The Unavoidable Lie: The detention is a standard legal procedure under judicial review.
